caption:
WHO WON THE KAWHI TRADE? 🦖🎒

📊 Kawhi: 19.5 PPG through 2 games. Ingram in L.A.: 0 games so far (still coming back from heel surgery)
🎒 What we gave up: Brandon Ingram (2026 All-Star), Gradey Dick (No. 13 pick in 2023), 1sts in 2031 and 2033, a 2027 pick swap and 2nds in 2030 and 2033
🎯 What we got: a 2x Finals MVP. 23 points and 4 steals opening night, 16 and 9 in Washington
🩹 Now he's out with swelling in his left knee
🏀 Gradey in L.A.: 46.7% from three through 9 games, 15 on New Orleans
📈 Standings: we're 5-5, the Clippers are 2-7

Right now we're winning it. Ask me again in 2033 👇

So who actually won this trade?

plus first-rounders in twenty thirty-one and twenty thirty-three,
a pick swap, and two second-rounders.
That's a lot.
Here's what we got:
a two-time Finals MVP.

facts.claim: Opening night Oct 21, 2026 vs Chicago: Raptors won 135-92, a 43-point win; Kawhi 23 PTS, 4 STL (game 401909837). Oct 23 at Washington: 16 points, 9 rebounds

On September 14, 2026, Ingram was officially traded to the Clippers along with Gradey Dick, Toronto's 2031 and 2033 1st round picks (2 firsts, X2), 2030 and 2033 2nd round picks (2 seconds, X2), and a 2027 1st round pick swap (X1) in exchange for Leonard: five (5) draft picks. Ingram was a 2026 NBA All-Star. May 8, 2026: right heel surgery
Ingram has played 0 games for the Clippers in 2026-27 (no 2026-27 row in his ESPN stats; injury note: nearing a return from surgery)
Gradey Dick was selected by the Raptors with the 13th overall selection (No. 13) in the 2023 NBA draft (X1)
Kawhi Leonard: 2 (2X) NBA champion and 2x Finals MVP; October 27, 2026: out with swelling in his left knee
Nov 9, 2026: Gradey Dick 15 points for the Clippers vs New Orleans (game 401909950); through 9 games he shoots 46.7% from three, about 47% (shown as 46.7 3P%)
